title: Harness Engineering Explained in Just 60 Seconds
description:
A harness is everything around the model: the tools it can call, how it remembers context, how it checks its own work, and when it knows to stop. 

It's the difference between an AI agent that runs for hours without supervision and one that quietly goes off the rails. Anthropic and OpenAI have both published deep research on this in 2026, and it's quickly becoming the most important layer in agentic AI systems.

Prompt engineering is old news. 

The skill that actually determines whether an AI agent works reliably is called harness engineering and most people have never heard of it. 

Comment "harness" if you want a full breakdown of how to build one for your own AI workflow.
